crossRefs.note: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah…
Then Joshua built an altar to Yahweh, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal,

people.name: Ebal_Mount
people.line: A mountain in Canaan, site of curses and blessings ceremony.

people.name: Gerizim_Mount
people.line: Mountain in Samaria; site of blessings and Jotham's parable

translations.web: It shall happen, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land that you go to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.
translations.bsb: When the LORD your God brings you into the land you are entering to possess, you are to proclaim the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.
translations.asv: And it shall come to pass, when Jehovah thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt set the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.
